description: This file implements a SugarOAuthServer class for handling OAuth 1.0 provider operations within the SuiteCRM project. It manages OAuth token validation, consumer lookup, nonce checking, and token generation, serving as a core component for OAuth authentication flow in the application.

classes.name: SugarOAuthServer
classes.description: Implements OAuth provider logic, including token handling, consumer lookup, nonce and timestamp verification, and OAuth request processing.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that necessary PHP functions (mhash or hash_hmac) exist for OAuth support.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Checks if OAuth functionality is enabled based on available hash functions.

methods.name: lookupConsumer
methods.description: Finds and validates a consumer (client application) by its key.

methods.name: timestampNonceChecker
methods.description: Checks the freshness and uniqueness of the provided timestamp and nonce.

methods.name: tokenHandler
methods.description: Validates the provided OAuth token, ensuring it matches and is in correct state.

methods.name: decodePostGet
methods.description: Decodes and sanitizes incoming POST and GET parameters for OAuth processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth provider, setting handlers and verifying requests.

methods.name: requestToken
methods.description: Generates a new OAuth request token.

methods.name: accessToken
methods.description: Generates an OAuth access token after validation.

methods.name: authUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL where the user can authorize the OAuth request.

methods.name: authorizedToken
methods.description: Returns the current token if it is an authorized access token.

methods.name: authorization
methods.description: Retrieves authorization data associated with the current token.
